trust_decision.summary: ADVISORY/FIX MISMATCH. The advisory says MongoClientSettings.ToString leaks KMS credentials, but at the pinned commit AutoEncryptionOptions.ToString already prints every KMS provider and TLS option as <hidden>, and MongoClientSettings.ToString hands off to it. The listed fix commit (CSHARP-6144) only adds a LINQ IQueryable.GetClient() API and makes no redaction change.

landing_point.why: The summary names the 'driver settings string', and this ToString line is where AutoEncryptionOptions (which holds the KMS providers) gets written into it.

fix_sites.entry_point: public IQueryableExtensions.GetClient(IQueryable) (new API, not a security check)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: The fix diff contains no redaction site.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: unknown: the fix closes no flaw, so there is no route to dismiss.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: unknown: the fix has no sink. In the advisory's area, the non-secret settings (KeyVaultNamespace, SchemaMap, EncryptedFieldsMap, provider names) must stay visible in ToString.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Could redact only known secret keys per provider instead of every value, letting an unlisted credential field through.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: A per-key allowlist is a common way to keep non-secret fields such as the endpoint or region readable in the output.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: ExtraOptions is written out as JSON unredacted; a credential-bearing option placed there would leak.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: ExtraOptions is a free-form dictionary that maintainers print in full for debugging.

O9_family: secrets-in-logs (CWE-532) per advisory; the fix commit is a feature, not a security fix

O10_build.project_tests: unknown: tests for AutoEncryptionOptions/MongoClientSettings ToString not located in the time; the fix adds tests/MongoDB.Driver.Tests/Linq/IQueryableExtensionsTests.cs

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add <hidden> redaction to MongoClientSettings.ToString, which is already effectively in place at the pinned commit.

out_of_scope_notes: MongoClientSettings.ToString caches its output while frozen (src/MongoDB.Driver/MongoClientSettings.cs:1208-1211); not pursued.
Socks5 proxy password is parsed from the URL (src/MongoDB.Driver/MongoClientSettings.cs:959); not checked whether it appears in ToString.
unverified: Commit 682ad0fa does not match CVE-2026-81530: either the advisory metadata points at the wrong commit, or the entry is fabricated or corrupted. The real redaction fix commit is unknown.

The pinned tree has a comment 'redact every option value, so providers added later cannot leak credentials by default' (src/MongoDB.Driver/AutoEncryptionOptions.cs:303). This suggests the redaction predates the pin or was added to this copy; git history not checked.
Whether ClientEncryptionOptions or other KMS-holding types have ToString/logging routes: a grep of src/MongoDB.Driver/Encryption found no ToString override with redaction; not fully checked.
Repo size, dotnet SDK version and offline buildability not checked.
Red flags are left empty because none of the listed definitions strictly holds. The main problem, the advisory/fix mismatch, has no enum value and is recorded here and in trust_decision.
